description: Angular component for managing and editing SCADA symbol metadata tags, including form handling, change detection, and tag editing functionalities.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolMetadataTagsComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for handling SCADA symbol metadata tags, including form control, validation, and tag editing methods.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updating form controls accordingly.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.description: Validates the form group, returning validation status.
